title: Bounded Burnside Problem
exact_target: Which numbers of generators and exponents give a finite free Burnside group? The question includes, specifically, the exponent-five group on two generators.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1109 (ALG-009). CC BY 4.0.
Miguel Donoso-Echenique and Eduardo Silva, \emph{Free Burnside groups of large odd exponent have cost 1}, arXiv:2608.20472 (2026), Section 1.
